title: Statistical or community area
description: A geographic area with no governing authority of its own: a statistical area, neighbourhood, planning area, service area, postal area. This is plain schema.org `Place`. A `Jurisdiction` is governed territory and has an organization; this has neither. Both can have `Boundary` records and be the subject of an `Observation`.

@type.description: Always `Place`, a real schema.org type. Not `AdministrativeArea`: that is reserved for jurisdictions.

containedInPlace.description: The area or jurisdiction this lies wholly within. Strict containment only.

geoOverlaps.description: Areas that partly overlap this one without either containing the other.

boundary.description: `Boundary` records for this area, including superseded ones. Statistical areas are redrawn on a schedule, so the date matters.

identifier.description: Scheme-qualified identifiers: a statistical agency's geographic code, for example.
